pages.title: Day 14
pages.text: $(italic)Still no extraction.$(br2)Holt left this morning. Took the compass and the last of the ration packs. Said she'd send someone back.$(br2)I told her the radio's still broadcasting. She said it doesn't matter if nobody's listening.$(br2)She's probably right.$()

pages.title: Day 17
pages.text: $(italic)The snow is up to the table now. I can hear the radio through it. Still looping. Same coordinates. Same voice.$(br2)Funny thing — I never noticed before, but the voice on the recording isn't any of us. It's not Holt. It's not Command. I don't know whose voice it is.$(br2)It just keeps reading coordinates.$(br2)I think I'll follow them tomorrow.$()
